buffer_target_precise_verbose <- function(polys, target_area, max_steps = 50, tol = 0.01) {
  polys <- st_make_valid(polys)
  area_now <- as.numeric(st_area(polys))
  area_now[area_now <= 0] <- NA
  
  # Initiële schatting van bufferafstand
  scale_factor <- sqrt(target_area / area_now)
  base_length  <- sqrt(area_now)
  buffer_dist  <- base_length * (scale_factor - 1)
  buffer_dist[!is.finite(buffer_dist)] <- 0
  
  final_buf <- polys
  done <- rep(FALSE, length(buffer_dist))
  
  cat("=== Vectorized stappen ===\n")
  for (i in 1:max_steps) {
    to_update <- which(!done)
    if (length(to_update) == 0) break
    
    polys_buf <- st_buffer(polys[to_update, ], buffer_dist[to_update])
    area_buf <- as.numeric(st_area(polys_buf))
    diff_ratio <- sqrt(target_area / area_buf)
    diff_ratio[!is.finite(diff_ratio)] <- 1
    buffer_dist[to_update] <- buffer_dist[to_update] * diff_ratio
    
    final_buf[to_update, ] <- polys_buf
    done[to_update] <- abs(area_buf - target_area) / target_area < tol
    
    # Print overzicht per tuin
    overview <- data.frame(
      tuin = to_update,
      buffer = round(buffer_dist[to_update], 2),
      area = round(area_buf, 2),
      diff = round(area_buf - target_area, 2),
      binnen_tol = done[to_update]
    )
    print(overview)
    
    cat("Stap ", i, ": nog ", sum(!done, na.rm = TRUE), " tuinen buiten tolerantie\n\n")
  }
  
  # Pas uniroot toe op afwijkers
  afwijkers <- which(!done)
  if (length(afwijkers) > 0) {
    cat("=== Exact corrigeren met uniroot ===\n")
    for (idx in afwijkers) {
      f <- function(d) {
        as.numeric(st_area(st_buffer(polys[idx, ], d))) - target_area
      }
      root <- tryCatch({
        uniroot(f, interval = c(-100, 100))$root
      }, error = function(e) {
        NA
      })
      if (!is.na(root)) {
        final_buf[idx, ] <- st_buffer(polys[idx, ], root)
        cat("Tuin ", idx, ": uniroot buffer =", round(root,2), 
            ", nieuw oppervlak =", round(as.numeric(st_area(final_buf[idx, ])), 2), "\n")
      } else {
        cat("Tuin ", idx, ": uniroot kon geen oplossing vinden\n")
      }
    }
  } else {
    cat("Alle tuinen binnen tolerantie na vectorized stappen\n")
  }
  
  return(list(buffered = final_buf, afwijkers = afwijkers))
}

  # Define a function to compute mean BIMD per buffer zone
compute_bimd_mean <- function(buffer_layer, buffer_dist) {
  bimd_join <- st_join(buffer_layer, Vulnerability)

  bimd_summary <- bimd_join %>%
    group_by(rowID) %>%
    summarise(
        !!paste0("IMDhe", buffer_dist) := mean(as.numeric(HEAL_S), na.rm = TRUE) ,
        !!paste0("IMDc",  buffer_dist) := mean(as.numeric(CRIM_S), na.rm = TRUE) ,
        !!paste0("IMDho", buffer_dist) := mean(as.numeric(HOUS_S), na.rm = TRUE) ,
        !!paste0("IMDed", buffer_dist) := mean(as.numeric(EDU_S),  na.rm = TRUE),
        !!paste0("IMDem", buffer_dist) := mean(as.numeric(EMP_S),  na.rm = TRUE) ,
        !!paste0("IMDi",  buffer_dist) := mean(as.numeric(INC_S),  na.rm = TRUE),
        !!paste0("ONSUNEMP", buffer_dist) := mean(as.numeric(UNEMP), na.rm = TRUE),
        !!paste0("ONSHH1",   buffer_dist) := mean(as.numeric(HH1),  na.rm = TRUE),
        !!paste0("ONSHH_K",  buffer_dist) := mean(as.numeric(HH_K),  na.rm = TRUE),
        !!paste0("ONSRent",  buffer_dist) := mean(as.numeric(Rent),  na.rm = TRUE),
        !!paste0("ONSEDU",   buffer_dist) := mean(as.numeric(EDU),   na.rm = TRUE),
        !!paste0("ONSEld",   buffer_dist) := mean(as.numeric(Eld),   na.rm = TRUE),
        !!paste0("ONSEU",    buffer_dist) := mean(as.numeric(EU),    na.rm = TRUE),
        !!paste0("ONSN_EU",  buffer_dist) := mean(as.numeric(N_EU),  na.rm = TRUE)
    )

  return(bimd_summary)
}

# Apply function to all buffer distances
bimd_0  <- compute_bimd_mean(adp_koppel_tuinen, 0)
bimd_50 <- compute_bimd_mean(adp_koppel_tuinen_buffer50, 50)
bimd_100 <- compute_bimd_mean(adp_koppel_tuinen_buffer100, 100)
bimd_200 <- compute_bimd_mean(adp_koppel_tuinen_buffer200, 200)
bimd_400 <- compute_bimd_mean(adp_koppel_tuinen_buffer400, 400)

# Drop geometry before merging
bimd_0 <- st_drop_geometry(bimd_0)
bimd_50 <- st_drop_geometry(bimd_50)
bimd_100 <- st_drop_geometry(bimd_100)
bimd_200 <- st_drop_geometry(bimd_200)
bimd_400 <- st_drop_geometry(bimd_400)

# Merge all summaries into main garden polygons
adp_koppel_tuinen <- adp_koppel_tuinen %>%
  left_join(bimd_0,   by = "rowID") %>%
  left_join(bimd_50,  by = "rowID") %>%
  left_join(bimd_100, by = "rowID") %>%
  left_join(bimd_200, by = "rowID") %>%
  left_join(bimd_400, by = "rowID")
  
#EXPOSURE
# Define a function to compute mean exposure per buffer
compute_exposure_mean <- function(buffer_layer, buffer_dist, exposure_layer, exposure_col = "Pop_densit_norm") {
  
  # Spatial join: assign exposure values to each garden/buffer
  exp_join <- st_join(buffer_layer, exposure_layer)
  
  # Compute mean exposure per polygon (rowID)
  exp_summary <- exp_join %>%
    group_by(rowID) %>%
    summarise(
      !!paste0("exp", buffer_dist) := mean(as.numeric(.data[[exposure_col]]), na.rm = TRUE)
    )
  
  return(exp_summary)
}

# Apply function to all buffers
exp_0   <- compute_exposure_mean(adp_koppel_tuinen, 0, exposure)
exp_50  <- compute_exposure_mean(adp_koppel_tuinen_buffer50, 50, exposure)
exp_100 <- compute_exposure_mean(adp_koppel_tuinen_buffer100, 100, exposure)
exp_200 <- compute_exposure_mean(adp_koppel_tuinen_buffer200, 200, exposure)
exp_400 <- compute_exposure_mean(adp_koppel_tuinen_buffer400, 400, exposure)

# Drop geometry before merging
exp_0   <- st_drop_geometry(exp_0)
exp_50  <- st_drop_geometry(exp_50)
exp_100 <- st_drop_geometry(exp_100)
exp_200 <- st_drop_geometry(exp_200)
exp_400 <- st_drop_geometry(exp_400)

# Merge all exposure summaries into main garden polygons

  left_join(exp_0,   by = "rowID") %>%
  left_join(exp_50,  by = "rowID") %>%
  left_join(exp_100, by = "rowID") %>%
  left_join(exp_200, by = "rowID") %>%
  left_join(exp_400, by = "rowID")

  # SOCIAL VULNERABILITY
  adp_koppel_tuinen$vul <- rowMeans(st_drop_geometry(adp_koppel_tuinen)[, c("IMDhe0", "IMDc0","IMDho0","ONSUNEMP0","ONSHH10","ONSHH_K0","ONSRent0","ONSEDU0","ONSEld0","ONSEU0","ONSN_EU0")], na.rm = TRUE)
